title: Avoid GitHub issue links and user docstring churn for internal command details

note.title: Avoid GitHub issue links and user docstring churn for internal command details
answers: Are GitHub issue or pull request links allowed in Click docstrings?
Where should platform-specific implementation notes for termui be documented?
Should internal pager command splitting details be exposed in user-facing docstrings?
note.body:
Convention: Do not include GitHub issue or PR links in public docstrings or code comments.
Enforced in `src/click/_termui_impl.py:pager` review; explain platform rationale directly in inline comments above relevant code rather than user docstrings.
User docstrings should describe user-facing behavior, leaving implementation history and platform quirks to internal comments.
note.applies: Writing docstrings and code comments in click._termui_impl.
